text:
ashley: ok team — weekly capacity deep-dive. posting the quick numbers and risks so we can handshake on what to lock in for next week.

ashley: TL;DR: US-W 36h runway (50% reserved, 50% preemptible), EU-W 22h (preemptible-heavy), APAC 58h (healthy). Marketing promo on Tue expected +28% GPU-hour demand for TRUNCATE model traffic.

tom: thanks. can you paste the cluster breakout?

ashley: sure — short table pasted from the deck:
- us-west-1: 12 nodes (A100), 2,400 GPU-hours/week available, burnrate ~66 GPU-hrs/hr -> runway ~36h
- eu-west-1: 8 nodes (V100 mixed), 1,050 GPU-hours/week available, burnrate ~48 GPU-hrs/hr -> runway ~22h (spot reclaim rate ~12% last 24h)
- apac-sg: 14 nodes (A100), 3,900 GPU-hours/week available, burnrate ~68 GPU-hrs/hr -> runway ~58h

lee: eu-west looks tight. are any jobs spiking network egress that might be slowing batch throughput? last night we saw degraded batch completion times.

priya: yes saw that. opened ticket INF-4231 — seems a misconfigured egress rule from a new feature branch, caused retries and extra token generation.

ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled maintenance eu-west-1 network fabric on 2425080000 (in 2 days) — expected 15min rolling packet loss windows.

jordan: can we avoid promo traffic hitting eu-west during the maintenance window? prefer routing to APAC/US.

ashley: yes — proposal: add a temporary routing rule to prefer us-west and apac for the promo traffic window (Tue 09:00-15:00 UTC), fallback to eu-west if latency SLO breaches.

tom: what about costs? shifting APAC will increase egress & inter-region costs; how much delta?

ashley: rough calc: moving 30% of EU traffic to APAC for 6 hours -> ~$2.6k extra egress + ~1.2k compute delta due to hotter utilization (more burst instances). still cheaper than paying for urgent reserved capacity.

lee: EU spot reclaim at 12% is concerning. Can we bump up the minimum nodes in eu-west autoscaler to avoid mid-job preemptions?

priya: autoscaler min increase is ok but that increases cost baseline. alternative: pin critical long-running inference to the reserved pool tag `resv-critical` and let ephemeral work continue on spots.

ashley: action items: 1) priya to tag model-service-critical containers with resv-critical (INF-4234) 2) tom to add routing rule for promo and publish plan (INF-4235) 3) jordan to monitor fallback latency thresholds and be on-call Tue (INF-4236)

jordan: I'll take 3. set an alert at p95 latency > 420ms and error rate > 0.6% for the route.

ops-bot: ALERT: eu-west-1 spot reclaim spike logged — 3 preemptions in the last 30m (node IDs: n-4c2, n-77a, n-19b).

lee: linking recent `kubectl describe pod` dump from the failed job for context:
```
Name: model-batch-2026-03
Status: Failed
Reason: Evicted (Preemption)
Event: NodePreempted at 2026-03-10T22:14:01Z
```

priya: thanks — I'll update the job launcher to checkpoint more frequently for batch windows overlapping the promo. small code bump in the launcher (5-line change) should drop wasted GPU-hours by ~12%.

tom: schedule wise — do we want to convert one eu-west machine type from mixed V100 to a single A100 spare this sprint to smooth capacity? cost estimate for 1 A100 reserved monthly ~ $14k.

ashley: prefer not to commit reserved $$ mid-week. alternative: shift one spare from apac (we're above runway) to eu-west as a temporary rebalancing. network ops will handle cross-region relocation of the instance image.

jordan: rebalancing sounds good. note: cross-region cold-boot will add ~8-12min extra startup for that node.

ashley: updated plan: do not buy reserved. Move 1 spare A100 from APAC to EU (INF-4237), apply routing pref for Tue 09-15 UTC (INF-4235), checkpointing fix deployed by priya by EOD Mon (INF-4238).

emily: +1 on checkpointing. can we also enable more aggressive KV cache reuse on the promo endpoints? small config change in serving runtime might cut token compute ~6%.

lee: I can push the runtime config to staging now, need a quick smoke test.

priya: will pair with lee for smoke.

ashley: last note — runway numbers will be updated tomorrow morning after batch of internal jobs finish. if anything changes before the promo, call an ad-hoc ops huddle.

tom: thanks, all. I'll drop the routing PR and tag the infra-ops reviewers. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: THREAD CLOSED (no activity for 1h)
